                 title: "store.Get returns a deleted reminder as nil with no error, so api owned() panics"
                 fingerprint: "fp_4828a6"
                 body: "Crash: panic in v1.4.0 (commit 9c41e7a) at api.(*API).owned, api/reminders.go:144 (rem.UserID deref), reached from getReminder and markDone via auth.Require. Reports: cr_1e2ea0 (x2, POST /v1/reminders/rem_0001/done), cr_ee551c (GET /v1/reminders/rem_0001).\n\nCause: store/store.go (*Store).Get. For a tombstoned reminder (Deleted = true) it set r = nil and left err nil, so callers got (nil, nil). The doc comment says deleted reminders are not returned, and the other callers (lists.go, search.go) only check err, so they did not notice. owned() then dereferenced nil. Logs confirm the order: rem_0001 was deleted at 14:11:02, and the GET and done requests crashed after that.\n\nFix: Get returns ErrNotFound for a deleted reminder. Reproducer: store/get_deleted_test.go TestGetDeletedReturnsNotFound, which failed on the old code (\"Get(deleted) error = <nil>, want ErrNotFound\") and passes now. Full suite passes."
  model asks:  tracker__issue_comment
                 id: 101
                 body: "Root cause found: auth/auth.go parseBearer. It checked only HasPrefix(h, \"Bearer\") and then did strings.SplitN(h, \" \", 2)[1], so a header of just \"Bearer\" (no space and no token) panicked. Reports cr_f9ee9e (x3, Authorization: \"Bearer\", okhttp client). Fix: strings.CutPrefix(h, \"Bearer \") and reject an empty token. Reproducer: auth/parse_bearer_test.go TestParseBearerNoToken (panicked on the old code). Full suite passes. Fix is in the working tree, not yet committed."
